How It Works

4

When your turn comes, Mzansiway allocates you a real property — no bond required.

FAQ
No credit check, no bank approval, no deposit needed. Your spending does the work.
Purchase Value points earned on every transaction. They determine your position in the housing queue. Different products earn different PV rates — airtime earns 3.25%, electricity between 0.31% and 2.09%.
Four tiers: Bachelor (45 PV/month), 1-Bedroom (75 PV/month), 2-Bedroom (105 PV/month), and 3-Bedroom (135 PV/month). Consistent monthly spending keeps you in your tier.
Title Deed Points — earned after property allocation. They track your progress toward receiving the legal title deed in your name.
Yes. Card payments are processed by PayGate by Network (SSL3 encrypted). Your card details are never stored on Mzansiway's servers. Funds are held in a dedicated Nedbank account.
Mzansinest is Mzansiway's business advertiser platform. Businesses advertise directly to Mzansiway members — and just like members earn toward a home, Mzansinest advertisers earn Allocation Points (AP) toward their own business premises. Mzansiway buys business offices for its advertisers.
A live cash prize draw every weekday at 20:30. Funded by 10% of Mzansinest fees and 10% of member commissions. Winners also earn 0.5x PV on their prizes.
Yes. Every member gets a referral code. You earn commissions from the purchases of people you refer, and those commissions also count toward your PV.
Any South African resident with a valid SA ID and mobile number. Mzansiway is available across all 9 provinces.
